noop_attempt.reason: CLAUDECODE=1 env var present — nested Claude Code session detected. Per autonomous_host_runner.py policy, nested invocation is not attempted when CLAUDECODE is set. This prevents infinite session nesting.
noop_attempt.expected_error: Claude Code cannot be launched inside another Claude Code session

policy_compliance.rule: Do not attempt nested invocation unless policy explicitly allows it
policy_compliance.source: Phase 1 requirement 2: If CLAUDECODE is present, do not attempt nested invocation unless policy explicitly allows it

wiring_instructions.description: To prove live host invocation, run from an EXTERNAL terminal (not inside Claude Code):
wiring_instructions.step_1: Open a new terminal window outside Claude Code
wiring_instructions.step_3: Run: claude --print -p "Respond with exactly: HOST_RUNNER_NOOP_OK. Do not modify files. Do not run commands."
wiring_instructions.command: claude --print -p "Respond with exactly: HOST_RUNNER_NOOP_OK. Do not modify files. Do not run commands."

impact_on_pilot: Pilot proceeds in SUPERVISED_AUTONOMOUS_PILOT_ONLY mode. No claim of fully unattended autonomy. All pilot execution is supervised (Babar manually starts Claude Code). This is not a product defect — it is a runtime environment constraint.
